name: Greater Cautery
primary:
A zone at the aim point with a 3.7-block radius for 12 s. Every second, on everyone inside, including you (damage and control only hit enemies):
• Damage 2.5 ❤ fire (fire ×0.5 on wet)
• Heat: sets on fire for 12 s (wet targets just dry off), thaws; melts ice and burns roots
• Heals 2 ❤
• Regeneration: +1 ❤ every 2 s for 8 s
• Growth: up to 4 nearby blocks — crops +2 stages, dirt turns to grass, roots grow upward
self_description:
